request.description: Create a contract with default dates. If not provided, startDate defaults to current date and endDate is null (open-ended contract). A person holds at most one LAMAL at a time: 409 contractOverlap if the period overlaps an active LAMAL of that person, future ones included (the end date is exclusive; ended or closed LAMAL do not count).
Create a contract with specific start and end dates (ISO 8601 format without timezone - Swiss time assumed).
Create an open-ended contract (no end date - Swiss time assumed).

query.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, min: 1, max: 100)

request.description: Get all active contracts for a client (paginated). Returns only contracts where current date < end date (or endDate is null). Default page size is 20, max is 100. Results are always sorted by last modification, most recent first; a sort parameter is ignored. Response format: {content: [...], pageNumber, pageSize, totalElements, totalPages, first, last}

item.name: Get Contracts - Filter By Update Date

query.description: Filter contracts by lastModifiedDate (ISO 8601 format without timezone - Swiss time assumed)

request.description: Get active contracts updated since a specific date (Swiss time assumed), with pagination support.

query.description: Number of contracts per page (default: 100, min: 1, max: 1000)
Opaque cursor: the nextCursor of the previous page, unchanged. Removed automatically when exportCursor is empty (first page).

request.description: Export the contracts active at request time, of all clients, ordered by id (keyset pagination, ADR-019). Send the request repeatedly: the first call has no cursor, the test script stores each nextCursor in the exportCursor variable and clears it on the last page (nextCursor null), so the next call starts a new export. A contract whose cost changes during the export is neither skipped nor exported twice. An invalid cursor returns 400 with code invalidCursor; a size outside 1..1000 returns 400 with code invalidParameter. Response format: {items: [...], nextCursor}

Import up to 1000 contracts, all or nothing (ADR-021). 201: {importedCount, contractIds} in the order of the lines; do not send it again, the contracts would be created twice. 422 contractImportRejected: nothing was created, the rejections property lists each problem with its zero-based index, clientId, code (invalidContractCost, invalidContractPeriod, clientNotFound, contractTypeNotAllowed, contractOverlap) and message; fix the lines and send the whole import again. 422 invalidImportSize: no line or more than 1000. 422 validationError: missing or wrongly typed field, named contracts[n].field.

header.description: Optional. Send the same value again with the same file after a timeout: the first job is returned instead of importing twice. Use a new value for a new file.

request.description: Submit a CSV file for asynchronous, partial import (ADR-022). UTF-8, separator ';', first line clientId;type;startDate;endDate;costAmount (type: LAMAL, LAA or LPP), at most 500000 contracts and 50 MB. 202: Location header and job state; valid lines create their contract, the others are reported, so send only the rejected lines again. Idempotency-Key (optional, at most 255 characters, unique per counselor): the same key with the same file returns the first job; with another file, 422 idempotencyKeyReused; blank or too long, 400 invalidIdempotencyKey. 400 missingParameter: no file part. 413 importFileTooLarge: over 50 MB. 422 invalidImportFile: no data, wrong header, encoding other than UTF-8 or too many lines; nothing is stored.

Follow an import job (ADR-022): status (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED), totalLines, processedLines, importedCount, rejectedCount, createdAt, finishedAt, failureCode (unexpectedError, incompleteProcessing, tooManyAttempts, null unless FAILED), submittedBy, cancelledAt and cancelledBy. A COMPLETED job can contain rejected lines. After FAILED, lines already processed stay imported. 404 contractImportJobNotFound: unknown job.

List the lines rejected so far, ordered by line number (ADR-022). lineNumber is the line in the file, the header being line 1. Codes: invalidLineFormat, invalidContractCost, invalidContractPeriod, clientNotFound, contractTypeNotAllowed, contractOverlap. size: at most 100, otherwise 400 invalidParameter. 404 contractImportJobNotFound: unknown job.

Download the rejected lines as CSV (text/csv, attachment): lineNumber;rejectionCode;rejectionMessage;line, ordered by line number. The line column is the original line of the file: fix it and copy it into a new file to submit. Text columns are quoted, inner quotes doubled. A text value starting with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return is prefixed with an apostrophe so that a spreadsheet shows it as text (CSV injection): remove it before copying the line. 404 contractImportJobNotFound: unknown job.

query.description: Only the jobs of this counselor (username)

request.description: List the import jobs of every counselor, newest first, with the username of the counselor who submitted each one. submittedBy narrows the list to one counselor. size: at most 100, otherwise 400 invalidParameter.

Cancel a job in any state and close the contracts it created that are still active (end date = cancellation date). A running job stops at its current chunk, a pending job never runs. 200: {job, closedContracts}. Cancelling again changes nothing (closedContracts 0). A fixed file can then be submitted without active duplicates. 404 contractImportJobNotFound: unknown job.
Get a specific contract by its ID. Returns 404 if the contract does not exist.

Update the cost amount of a contract and its internal last modification date (used by the updatedSince filter). Only active (non-expired) contracts can be updated: an expired contract returns 409 with code contractExpired. Requires If-Match with the ETag of the contract ({{contractETag}} is filled by Get Contract By ID); the response carries no ETag, run Get Contract By ID again before another change. Missing If-Match or If-Match: * returns 428 (preconditionRequired); an ETag that is no longer current, including after the contract was closed by a client deletion, returns 412 (preconditionFailed). An invalid amount returns 422. Sending the same amount (scale-insensitive, e.g. 100.0 = 100.00) is a no-op: the contract is not modified.

Replace the period of a contract: send both dates as they must be after the change. startDate is required (422 validationError when missing or null); a missing or null endDate makes the contract open-ended. Only active (non-expired) contracts can be changed: an expired contract returns 409 (contractExpired). The new period of a LAMAL must not overlap another active LAMAL of the same person: 409 (contractOverlap). The start date may be moved into the past; the end date cannot be in the past and must be after the start date, otherwise 422 (invalidContractPeriod). A change updates the internal last modification date (updatedSince filter); sending the current period is a no-op. Requires If-Match with the ETag of the contract ({{contractETag}} is filled by Get Contract By ID): missing or * returns 428 (preconditionRequired), a stale ETag returns 412 (preconditionFailed).
Very performant endpoint using database aggregation. Returns the total of costAmount for all active contracts of a client.
